title: Canopy River ABC
hook: Water below, green overhead, onward we go.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: soft 3D rainforest-river storybook, emerald and aqua palette, rounded creatures and plants, clean scene separation

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child on an imagined slow river journey observing banks, water, trunks and canopy without claiming every target is aquatic
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: restart the gentle current and orient bank-below-overhead
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: flowing 3/4 with long downstream phrase tails
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written river-corridor scenes; each target is honestly placed on bank, ground, branch, canopy or water-adjacent space
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: river-position cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe flow/point gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. soft marimba droplets and hand-percussion answers, never masking words
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: soft marimba droplets and hand-percussion answers, never masking words
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Carry the alphabet along a rainforest river corridor where current, bank, overhanging canopy and reflected light connect objects that live at different heights.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child rides an imagined slow river route; recurring language uses bank, current, bend, reflection, overhang, downstream, crossing and shore.
imageMotifs: water vine and ginger at final bend
semanticArc: follow bends under animals and climbers
mid-route reflections mix canopy and water
return to a quiet landing downstream
